meta.title: Robert Football Coaching — Lee County, FL
meta.description: Professional football coaching in Cape Coral, FL. Training sessions for youth and high school athletes.

about.name: Coach Robert
about.bio:
I have been an athlete my entire life, competing in a variety of sports and maintaining a dedicated workout routine. As former Seahawks and Packers coach Mike Holmgren once said, "Coaching is teaching"—a philosophy I strongly believe in. (My teaching experience includes two years in Harbin, China, where I taught English and Economics to college students, further honing my ability to mentor and communicate effectively.)

I also had the privilege of meeting Coach Holmgren on Maui—an experience I will never forget.

I competed in the Northern California (NorCal) Junior Colleges conference in the 110 meter high hurdles and 400 meter intermediate hurdles and lettered both seasons. It was a great experience.

I also played in a hardball league in Seattle for 8 seasons, and managed for 2 seasons (Puget Sound Baseball League). I played every one of the 9 positions at one time or another!

Beyond my personal athletic background, I am enthusiastic about what sports can do for young people. I enjoy coaching both one-on-one and in small groups, and I understand how to set the right tone for a session, ensuring student-athletes stay focused and engaged.

hero.headline: Lee County's Premier Football Coach
